summary:
Summary – How ORBITAL Works
ORBITAL uses one engineering model to calculate all its numbers, based on real scientific principles. It uses the rocket equation to calculate velocity changes, orbital mechanics and Kepler's equation to determine spacecraft trajectories, and other models to calculate communication, temperature, solar power, and rocket performance. The spacecraft's movement is simulated using a realistic two-body orbital model with high precision. ORBITAL combines three types of elements:
Real: Physical constants and scientific principles.
Model: Simplified educational approximations used for simulations.
Fictional: The agency (OXD), crew, rockets, hardware, costs, and discoveries.
Overall, ORBITAL combines real physics, simplified models, and fictional elements to create an educational spaceflight simulation.
details: ORBITAL is a game in which the user has to complete space missions by fixing the models of the space crafts and directing the missions. The user can play as a cadet, engineer or a flight director. The users tasks and missions vary according to the role the user chooses. The use can also choose between 3 missions, which varies in tasks
